name: AI Content Creation System (Course Demo)
description: A Make.com blueprint for an AI-powered content creation pipeline. Reads topics from Google Sheets, drafts content with ChatGPT, formats the output, and stores the finished result. Designed as a teaching example for a digital course on AI workflows.

modules.name: Google Sheets - Watch Rows
modules.description: Monitors a Google Sheet for new content topics. Each row contains: topic title, target audience, tone (professional/casual/friendly), content type (blog/social/email), and reference notes.

configuration.filter: Status column is empty (unprocessed topics only)

modules.name: OpenAI (ChatGPT) - Create a Completion
modules.description: Sends the topic to ChatGPT with a structured prompt that includes the audience, tone, and content type. Returns a complete draft.

configuration.prompt_template: You are a content writer for a {{Target Audience}} audience. Write a {{Content Type}} about '{{Topic Title}}' in a {{Tone}} tone. Requirements: 1) Include a clear headline, 2) Break into scannable sections with subheadings, 3) Keep it practical with specific tips, 4) End with a clear next step or call to action. {{Reference Notes}}

modules.name: Text Parser - Format Output
modules.description: Cleans and formats the ChatGPT output. Trims whitespace, ensures consistent heading styles, and adds metadata (date created, content type, word count).

operations: Add metadata block: date, type, word count, audience
Check word count is within target range (300-800 for blog, 50-150 for social, 100-300 for email)

modules.name: Google Drive - Upload a File
modules.description: Saves the formatted content draft to a Google Drive folder organized by content type. File is named with the date and topic title.

modules.name: Google Sheets - Update a Row
modules.description: Updates the original topic row with the processing result. Marks the status as 'Drafted' and adds the Google Drive link for easy access.

update_columns.G: Google Drive link to the saved file

error_handling.strategy: Continue with next topic if one fails
error_handling.notifications: Log errors to a separate 'Errors' sheet tab
error_handling.retry: 1 automatic retry on API timeout, then skip and log

setup_instructions.step_1: Import this blueprint into Make.com (Scenarios > Create > Import Blueprint)
setup_instructions.step_2: Connect your Google account (for Sheets and Drive access)
setup_instructions.step_3: Connect your OpenAI account (API key from platform.openai.com)
setup_instructions.step_4: Create a Google Sheet called 'Content Calendar' with columns: Topic Title, Target Audience, Tone, Content Type, Reference Notes, Status
setup_instructions.step_5: Create a Google Drive folder called 'Content Drafts' with subfolders: blog, social, email
setup_instructions.step_6: Add a few test topics to your sheet and run the scenario manually to verify
setup_instructions.step_7: Once verified, turn on scheduling (every 15 minutes or your preferred interval)

course_context.learning_objective: Students learn to connect a data source (Google Sheets) to an AI tool (ChatGPT) to an output destination (Google Drive) using Make.com, creating a reusable content production system.
customization_points: Swap Google Sheets for Airtable or Notion
Change the prompt template for different content styles
Add an approval step before saving (for team workflows)
Add social media scheduling as a 6th module (Buffer, Later, etc.)
